heading: Questions? We can read your mind

items.q: What is the BBA (Hons) in Digital Branding & Advertising?
a: The BBA (Hons) in Digital Branding & Advertising is a 4-year undergraduate program focused on building skills in digital marketing, branding and communication. The program helps students understand how brands operate in a digital-first environment, with exposure to marketing strategy, content, media and emerging digital platforms.

items.q: Does the program include live projects or industry internships?
a: Yes, the program includes live projects and industry internships. Our strong emphasis on experiential learning and real-world projects shapes students into career-ready professionals for the competitive business world.

a: Yes, this program offers international exposure, too. The industry-endorsed curriculum and masterclass held by industry stalwarts ensure students gain a 360-degree learning experience.

items.q: What is the admission process for the BBA in Digital Branding & Advertising?
a: The admission process for BBA in Digital Branding & Advertising includes getting above 50% in State Boards, CBSE or ISC schools. Along with that, there is a selection process that includes an online aptitude test and a personal interview.
